messages:
alice: Deploy-bot started a staged rollout of v3.2.1 -> EU 10%. Eval-sweep (prompt-suite-longdocs) returned a fidelity regression on ~0.6% of inputs. Proposing to pin EU to v3.1.9 until triage. Opinions?

deploy-bot: rollout initiated — EU:10% -> v3.2.1, US:0% (manual) :rocket:

eval-bot: eval/suites/prompt-suite-longdocs 2026-03-21T09:12Z
  metric: summarization_fidelity_delta = -7.4% (p95)
  sample_failure_rate = 0.6% (12/2000)
  example_ids: ld-412, ld-903, ld-1197

carla: can you paste a diff of the failing outputs? quick glance will help.

alice: pasted two examples below
```diff
- expected: "...the quarterly results indicate stable growth and continued margin expansion across product lines."
+ actual:   "...results are good. the product is fine and sales high."
```

ben: this smells like a tokenizer/decoding edgecase on long docs after the quantization patch in v3.2.1. beam settings maybe interacting.

dinesh: if we pin eu->v3.1.9 via routing, how fast can we flip? we can apply a region route lock immediately but need to confirm capacity headroom.

pm-zoe: also need to update release notes / KB: call out long-doc summarization edgecase, mitigation steps, and expected ETA for fix.

carla: I'll rerun the sweep with stratified doc-length buckets and <beam=1,3,5> to see sensitivity. queuing now, should finish in ~15m.

eval-bot: rerun queued: stratified-longdocs (buckets: <2k,2-8k,>8k), beam=[1,3,5]. ETA ~12m.

alice: decision proposal: pin EU to v3.1.9, continue US at 50% to surface other regressions, open support ticket, update release notes, QA to confirm fix before unpin. Triage window: +2h.

dinesh: +1 on pin. I'll apply the region routing rule: region:eu -> model:v3.1.9 with fallback to v3.2.1 if capacity constrained.

pm-zoe: I'm on release-notes PR now, will flag the customer-facing blurb and internal mitigation steps.

carla: preliminary rerun (first bucket) — failure rate drops to 0.1% with beam=1, spikes at beam>=4. Reproducer attached in the rerun job. Looks correlated with long-document beam decoding.

alice: good catch. who owns the bisect if this narrows to a decoding change? eng-ml + runtime?

ben: SRE note — make sure US canary autoscale at 50% to avoid throttles while we keep EU pinned. I'll watch token/latency heatmaps.

alice: final: pin applied in EU at 2026-03-21T09:45Z, US roll moved to 50%. QA to sign off by 11:45Z or we escalate to rollback. tagging @carla @dinesh @pm-zoe :eyes:

pm-zoe: acknowledged, updating notes and creating support ticket in #support with links to failing examples.

deploy-bot: route update applied: eu -> v3.1.9 (pinned).
